items.title: 67395_Vic Dickenson oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Was that the band with Claude Hopkins and Doc Cheatham..?

ctx.x: Yeah. So I was kind of, like, in charge in the band,, but it wasn't really my band, you know.
Was that the band with Claude Hopkins and Doc Cheatham..? Buzzy Drootin
Cause that was after Perez Prado, then I went to Boston with Vic Dickenson at the Mahogany Hall.
And you were there for quite a while.
